comment: 4.6.3 addresses financing sources only and contains no underlying cost structure. DIIG in costing section warning — that budgets "frequently underestimated" because they focus on demonstration/deployment costs and omit long-term O&M — is exactly the risk a "Sustain and evolve" / recurrent-financing section should be guarding against, but 4.6.3 never uses the concept or term, and never warns against front-loaded budgeting.
